research.title: Evidence Sensitivity in Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
bullets: Designed experiments varying passage relevance, evidence ordering, and distractor content to evaluate answer grounding in retrieval-augmented question answering.
Analyzed answer correctness and supporting passage attribution, separating retrieval failures from generation errors through manual review of sampled responses.

research.title: Domain Robustness and Confidence Calibration in Intent Classification
bullets: Designed comparisons of sparse lexical and pretrained encoder classifiers under domain shifts, controlling training partitions and label distributions.
Analyzed calibration, selective prediction, and confusion patterns across domains, using bootstrap intervals and manual error categorization to interpret performance differences.

publications.title: Confidence Calibration and Selective Prediction for Intent Classification Under Domain Shift
Lexical and Encoder-Based Intent Classifiers Across Domains: A Comparative Error Analysis

work.title: Document Ingestion and Search Service Maintenance
bullets: Implemented document validation, text normalization, and duplicate handling within an ingestion service supporting searchable internal records.
Maintained ingestion tests and investigated indexing failures, documenting reproduction steps and coordinating fixes with downstream service maintainers.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Sequence Models for Entity Recognition
bullets: Implemented conditional random field and pretrained encoder baselines for entity recognition, using consistent tokenization alignment and evaluation splits.
Compared entity-level precision and recall, examining boundary errors, rare entity categories, and sensitivity to reduced training data.

projects.title: Lexical and Dense Retrieval for Passage Search
bullets: Implemented lexical ranking and dense embedding retrieval over a shared passage collection, standardizing query preprocessing and relevance judgments.
Compared ranking quality and query latency, reviewing cases involving exact terminology, paraphrases, and ambiguous queries to characterize retrieval differences.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with Frequency and Graph-Based Ranking
bullets: Implemented term frequency and graph-based sentence ranking for extractive summarization, applying shared sentence segmentation and summary length constraints.
Compared lexical overlap metrics and manually assessed redundancy, examining how sentence position and document length affected selected content.
